lines.t: Pulled up in my old sedan, heart hungry and fried,
Cravin’ mercy with a side of humble pie.
Menu glows like heaven’s gate, halos in neon light,
They’re servin’ up parables with ketchup on the side.
I said, “Can I get a Grace ‘n’ Cheese, maybe Doubt-Free Fries?”
The voice replied, “Child, that combo never dies.”
Welcome to McHalo’s, where your spirit gets refilled,
Drive-thru of devotion, where the soul’s flame is grilled.
From the Salvation Shake to the Mercy Nugget Meal,
Taste and see the truth — that’s the real deal!
Pulled to the window, brother smiles with holy fries,
Got scripture in his visor, and light in his eyes.
He said, “Son, before you sip that Amen Brew,
You might wanna read somethin’ that’ll change your view.”
He handed me a leaflet, said, “These words ain’t fluff,
They’re from *The Volumes of Truth* — that’s real tough love, The real God speakin’ stuff.
Today’s topic? Pride deluxe — best served humbled down,
Add a side of wisdom, and wear that crown!”
Welcome to McHalo’s, where your spirit gets refilled,
Drive-thru of devotion, where the soul’s flame is grilled.
From the Salvation Shake to the Mercy Nugget Meal,
Taste and see the truth — that’s the real deal!
I took my order, smiled real wide,
Said, “Thanks, my man, I’m sanctified!”
Rolled into the sunset, heart all aglow,
With The Volumes of Truth drivin’ my soul.
